# ankra_cluster_custom_dns_zone (Resource)

A DNS zone a cluster also serves with one of the organisation's own DNS credentials (an external-dns webhook, Avura or Cloudflare credential), alongside the generated domain Ankra serves. Ankra renders an external-dns scoped to exactly this zone. The counterpart of `ankra cluster custom-dns-zones add` and `remove`. Withdrawing the zone removes the controller; the zone's records are left untouched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster" "prod" {
  name = "prod"
}

resource "ankra_cluster_custom_dns_zone" "launch" {
  cluster_id          = data.ankra_cluster.prod.id
  zone                = "launch.example.com"
  credential_name     = "example-cloudflare"
  credential_provider = "cloudflare"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `credential_name` (String) Name of the organisation DNS credential that publishes into the zone. Changing it re-points the zone in place.
- `zone` (String) Zone to serve, e.g. `launch.example.com`. The platform stores it lower case without a trailing dot. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `credential_provider` (String) Kind the credential must be: `cloudflare`, `webhook` or `avura`. Unset accepts whichever kind the credential is, and the attribute then reports that kind.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<cluster_id>/<zone>`.
- `policy` (String) The external-dns policy the zone's controller runs: `upsert-only` for Cloudflare, `sync` otherwise.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Zones are imported by cluster id and zone name.
terraform import ankra_cluster_custom_dns_zone.launch 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666/launch.example.com
```
